notes: Complete accessible 181-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, covering all 8 chapters plus the MATLAB appendix and a full-document visual scan.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-003-QUANTITATIVE-TRADING-ERNEST-CHAN.md
The accessible PDF lists Preface and Acknowledgments in the table of contents but those sections are absent from the local artifact; REVIEWED applies to the complete accessible PDF.

No BTC alpha, signal weight, horizon, execution parameter, or System G2 rule is derived from this source.

sources.title: Systematic Trading: A Unique New Method for Designing Trading and Investing Systems
notes: Complete accessible 359-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all 15 chapters, epilogue, glossary, Appendices A-D, and full-document visual scan.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-004-SYSTEMATIC-TRADING.md

Key source domains: ideas-first research, fitting/overfitting, continuous normalized forecasts, correlation-aware forecast combination, robust weighting, volatility targeting, position sizing, portfolios, transaction-cost speed limits, position inertia, EWMAC and carry examples.

The book provides a professional precedent for stable structural weighting with cautious evidence-dependent performance adjustment, but no Trading Bot numeric weights or BTC parameters are derived from it.
Cross-asset/daily-futures architecture and author-specific numerical heuristics require BTC-specific evidence before any implementation.

sources.title: … and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
notes: Complete 101-page SSRN manuscript reviewed on 2026-09-27, including main text, full factor list, bibliography, Appendices A-E, and full-document visual scan.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-016-CROSS-SECTION-OF-EXPECTED-RETURNS.md
Source-grounded metadata: current manuscript version April 20, 2015; first posted to SSRN April 11, 2013.
Core use for Trading Bot is research-multiplicity governance: failed/hidden trials, correlated hypotheses, theory-vs-mining distinction, and stronger evidence after broad search.
The paper's t-statistic guidance is contextual to cross-sectional factor research and is not adopted as a universal BTC strategy threshold.

sources.title: Mathematical Appendices to “The Probability of Backtest Overfitting”
notes: Complete 8-page mathematical supplement reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all synthetic test cases, Monte Carlo benchmark, EVT/Gumbel derivation, Python snippets, and final accuracy table.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-017-MATHEMATICAL-APPENDICES-PROBABILITY-OF-BACKTEST-OVERFITTING.md
The appendix reports CSCV/PBO accuracy under controlled synthetic assumptions; it is not independent trading-alpha evidence.
Core project implication: candidate-search breadth and sample size jointly determine selection-overfit risk; complete trial logging is required.
No signal weight, BTC parameter, or strategy design is derived from this source.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
notes: Complete 34-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all 13 figures, formal definitions, CSCV algorithm, practical examples, limitations and misuse warnings.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-018-THE-PROBABILITY-OF-BACKTEST-OVERFITTING.md
Key scope: PBO evaluates strategy/configuration-selection overfit; it does not validate backtest correctness, costs, data timing, or future regime robustness.
Full legitimate trial disclosure is required; hiding failed trials or padding with obviously bad trials biases the diagnostic.
PBO/CSCV must not be used as the strategy-search objective itself.
No BTC alpha, signal weight, parameter, or System G2 rule is derived from this source.
